messages:
noah: Quick proposal: instead of adding many routing headers, have SDKs emit one compact token header `X-RW-RouteCtx` containing route_id|priority|sdk_ver encoded urlsafe-base64 (no padding). Advantages: single header to parse, lower cardinality, easier to extend. Thoughts?

reena: Single header is neat, but WAFs/CDNs sometimes strip headers with `=` or non-alphanum. urlsafe+no-padding helps. Need size limits (256 bytes?) and truncation policy.

omar: Console/ingest: we can decode token and index route_id & priority. Add field `route_ctx_version` and `route_ctx_source` (old,new,both). If both present prefer new token. Also track `route.ctx.decode_fail` metric.

jade: SDKs (py/ts/go) should provide a helper to build token and a env var RW_ROUTECTX_MODE: off|dual|canary|new. Default off. Dual emits both token and legacy `X-Redwood-Route` to keep old infra happy. Add token size guard and metric `route.ctx.truncated`.

ops-bot: edge-proxy/shim v7 scheduled to canary 2026-03-27T09:00:00Z

reena: Important: use urlsafe base64 without padding and strip `=`. Also include a short schema prefix like `v1|route-12|h|py:1.4.0` before encoding so ingest can evolve.

omar: Attribution: if token route_id differs from legacy header prefer token and emit `route.mismatch` sampled. Quota service will keep route_id as primary attribution key.

jade: Add per-tenant opt-out flag for shim mapping. Some customers want to preserve legacy behavior. Ops, can we support that?

ops-bot: yes, shard-level mapping toggle supported; will add tenant opt-out control.

noah: Timeline: PRs for SDK helpers this week, minor opt-in release in 7 days, shim to staging now, console ingest + adoption tile in 10 days. Evaluate adoption after 6 weeks then flip defaults. I'll draft migration doc & support FAQ.

reena: I'll add unit and e2e tests: decode roundtrip, truncation metric, header presence permutations.

omar: I'll wire ingest to emit adoption sparkline and a debug panel for sampled decoded tokens. Thanks — closing unless blockers.
